name: AUTO_EVAL_CEILING_SYNTHESIS
hypothesis: H4 (synthesis): The auto-evaluation ceiling is exactly the structural gate — schema validation + GOBLIN filter + admissibility rule A(c). Everything above that ceiling is reducer-domain and requires human authorization.
experiment: Synthesize E002–E004 into a two-layer evaluation architecture with a clean ceiling line.

layer_A_auto_eval.name: STRUCTURAL_GATE
what_it_checks: evidence array non-empty for OBSERVED/CONFIRMED status
risk field not HIGH for kernel_admissible=true

layer_B_reducer.name: SEMANTIC_GATE
what_it_checks: evidence hash integrity against actual source bytes
passage law compliance (SPECULATIVE ceiling, terminal flag timing)
truth_status elevation warranted by evidence quality

signals.ceiling_law: AUTO_EVAL_CEILING = STRUCTURAL_GATE_OUTPUT. No auto-eval output crosses into ADMITTED state. STRUCTURAL_PASS is a necessary condition, not a sufficient one.
key_invariants: STRUCTURAL_BLOCK = sufficient to stop (no further review needed)
SEMANTIC_GATE = mandatory for any ADMITTED or REPLAYABLE state

garden_receipt.promotion_status: GARDEN_ONLY — do not promote without peer-review + reducer + MAYOR

membrane_verdict: H4 SUPPORTED. Auto-evaluation ceiling is the structural gate. The reducer is the only path to ADMITTED. This distinction is the core finding.
